headline: Quiet weekend, only one video model worth a quick look
summary: Nothing big today, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is the only new release that really counts.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is out
items.pitch: Google's Omni line got a faster, cheaper Flash version that can make longer clips. It's getting a lot of buzz on HN.
why: Official new release, billed as cheaper and faster
Supports longer clips, handier for demo videos
232 comments on HN, so people are talking about it
actions: Open the DeepMind blog and read the Omni 1.2 Flash intro
Check the Gemini app to see if there's an entry point, the source doesn't say clearly
deep_dive: Omni is Google's "any input, any output" model line, and Flash is its fast, cheap tier.
The blog only gave a title and one line, I didn't see the actual pricing or max clip length, so don't jump to conclusions.
items.signals: HN 343 points · 232 comments · DeepMind official blog, November release

items.title: Small model stuck? Ask Opus, save 4x
items.pitch: Hightouch's post says letting Jev ask Opus for help when it needs to keeps accuracy steady while cutting cost by 4x.
why: The idea is let the cheap model go first, upgrade when it gets stuck
Agent bills might get cheaper down the road
